issue_request: FHIR-12380 was a Published Vocabulary change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2. It reported that the example ConceptMap repeated the map from FHIR address-use code "home" to v3 AddressUse code "H" and asked why equivalence relationships had disappeared; the approved resolution said the duplicate was addressed and the equivalence relationships would be restored as they were in DSTU3.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-12380. Git-svn commit 7ad0c6364e2c36a9bc3d92cb70f7aa22231970c3, titled "#12590 & #12617 - add default mappings and display to ConceptMap", removed the duplicate home-to-H entry from source/conceptmap/conceptmap-example.xml. Git-svn commit 72143f2fd3d86e1d1de43b7aab6821463d9611ab restored explicit equivalence values, and 049b740c24b9a670f52f04286093e41bc6f2d74d later migrated those to current ConceptMap relationship values.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini and the ConceptMap examples list includes ConceptMap/101 from source/conceptmap/conceptmap-example.xml. Later ConceptMap model changes renamed target.equivalence to target.relationship and replaced the old disjoint code with not-related-to. FHIR-12590 and FHIR-12617 share the 2017 source-history commit but are already represented on the combined branch and were not re-decided here.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active ConceptMap example contains exactly one source code "home" mapping to target code "H" with relationship="equivalent"; the work and temp mappings also carry relationship="equivalent"; the old mapping carries relationship="not-related-to"; and the unmapped fixed mapping carries relationship="related-to". This satisfies the published FHIR-12380 resolution in current ConceptMap terms.
